# Topic Model (LDA)

> Latent Dirichlet allocation, built from scratch: collapsed Gibbs sampling for topic discovery, with a Rust core that reproduces the Python sampler exactly, and UMass topic-coherence evaluation.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda

## Source

- [rust/src/gibbs.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/rust/src/gibbs.rs): Collapsed Gibbs sampling, step for step the same as the Python sampler.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of topic-model-lda: collapsed Gibbs sampling for latent Dirichlet allocation.
- [rust/src/mt.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/rust/src/mt.rs): CPython's `random.Random`: MT19937 with `init_by_array` seeding.
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `topic_model_lda_rs` extension module.
- [src/topic_model_lda/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/__init__.py): Topic Model LDA - latent Dirichlet allocation with collapsed Gibbs sampling.
- [src/topic_model_lda/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/cli.py): Command line interface for the LDA topic model.
- [src/topic_model_lda/corpus.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/corpus.py): Corpus types: tokenization and an integer-indexed document collection.
- [src/topic_model_lda/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/data.py): A bundled document collection with latent themes for demonstration.
- [src/topic_model_lda/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/evaluation.py): Topic-coherence evaluation.
- [src/topic_model_lda/lda.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/lda.py): Latent Dirichlet allocation with collapsed Gibbs sampling, from scratch.
- [src/topic_model_lda/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/topic_model_lda/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/topic-model-lda/blob/main/src/topic_model_lda/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained topic model.
